name: PayPal
description: PayPal Checkout: the customer approves the payment on PayPal, the shop captures it on return or by webhook, refunds from the admin.

settings.label: Environment
settings.help: Use the sandbox with sandbox app credentials until you go live.

settings.label: Client ID
settings.help: From developer.paypal.com → Apps & Credentials, for the environment chosen above.

settings.label: Secret
settings.help: The app's secret. Stored encrypted and never shown again.

settings.label: Webhook ID
settings.help: Add a webhook to https://your-shop/paypal/webhook for CHECKOUT.ORDER.APPROVED and PAYMENT.CAPTURE.* events, and paste its ID. Without it, payments are still captured when the customer returns.

author: PN Scripts
